items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: when you started rehearsing, we just rehearsed the first tune we were going to record... Stump Evans was in that -- on that recording date... Yeah.

ctx.x: Was his name Stump or Stomp? I've seen it both ways.
Now, you know, I don't remember. Because we always called him Stump.
